Material selection

Wax Paper vs. Baking Parchment

Wax paper

Wax paper is generally used for wrapping, separation and moisture resistance.

Baking parchment

Baking parchment is designed for nonstick baking and higher-temperature cooking applications.

Use reminder: Wax paper is intended for food wrapping, handling and separation applications. It should not be used as a substitute for baking parchment in direct high-temperature oven applications unless the selected specification has been confirmed for that use.

FAQ

Interfolded Deli Paper FAQ

Which formats are available for Interfolded Deli Paper?

Available specifications may include 6 × 10.75 in interfolded sheets, 8 × 10.75 in interfolded sheets, 10 × 10.75 in interfolded sheets, 12 × 10.75 in interfolded sheets. Final paper grade, construction, dimensions and packaging are subject to confirmation.

Can wax paper replace baking parchment?

Wax paper is generally used for wrapping, handling, separation and moisture resistance. It should not be used as a substitute for baking parchment in direct high-temperature oven applications unless the selected specification is confirmed for that use.

Which dry wax paper constructions and pack counts are available?

The standard options are 23 gsm base paper + 5 gsm wax or 30 gsm base paper + 5 gsm wax. Both are available in 6 × 10.75, 8 × 10.75, 10 × 10.75, 12 × 10.75 and 15 × 10.75 inch sheets, packed 500 sheets per box.

Can LANGMAI provide custom sizes and printing?

Yes, for applicable specifications. Send the sheet or roll dimensions, artwork, colors, food use, order quantity and packaging requirements for review and sample planning.

How are PFAS and food-contact documents confirmed?

Documents and any third-party testing are reviewed against the selected paper, coating, ink system, finished format, intended food contact and destination market. One report should not be assumed to cover every construction.

What information is required for a quote?

Send the product, food application, paper color and grammage if known, sheet or roll dimensions, printing, destination country, order quantity, food-contact conditions and required documents.
